# SetSamplerLodBias <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetSamplerLodBias:Void sampler:Int32, bias:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sampler` | In | Int32 | required | The sampler to change. |
| `bias` | In | Float32 | required | The number of levels to add to the level that is picked. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Moves the point where the mip levels change. A positive bias uses the smaller (blurrier) levels sooner, a negative bias keeps the bigger (sharper) levels for longer, which looks sharper but can shimmer. 0 is the default. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals read every texture with the settings of its flags and do not have samplers.

## Differences

* The graphics card has a limit for the bias, and the value is kept inside of it.
